sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Graphictac is a family-owned OEM/ODM/OBM manufacturer of self-adhesive vinyl material and printable films for production shops, sign makers, and fleet graphics.

Industry: Materials & Manufacturing · HQ: Taiwan · Size: 50-249 · Products: Printable vinyl films, Laminates, Chrome films, Holographic media, Window films, Car wrapping films

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Graphictac USA scores 86 of 100 (tier A) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (30/30), application fit (25/25), company size (6/15), event engagement (15/15) and pain-point alignment (10/15).

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on weatherability, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (60% similar on vinyl, films, specialty, media); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (55% similar on films, vinyl, graphics, fleet); Drytac (38% similar on films, media, vinyl, graphics). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
